Description.SourceString:
Our fortune has taken to the sky! A floating treasure chest. Airborne doubloons! I have seen it! There it goes again, mocking me. I swear there’s something spread beneath it, corners flapping in the wind. Around the pyramid again, always just ahead of me. I can see it dancing over the stones.

One more turn and I’ll catch it. Then I’ll bring back every coin, embrace my brothers and divide it fairly. They’ll forgive me. They must. No one need hear what we said. Just one more turn...
